# Zstd (decompress-only)

Vendored [facebook/zstd](https://github.com/facebook/zstd) **v1.5.6** single-file decompressor (`zstddeclib.c`), generated with `build/single_file_libs/combine.py` (legacy support excluded).

Used to read DeepSeek Harness session logs (`session*.jsonl.zstd` under `~/.dsh/sessions`). Dual-licensed BSD / GPLv2 — see `LICENSE` and `COPYING`.
